title: ID0445039-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R4 170001688] QA1 Failure In Feedback Line
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: QA1 failure in feedback line
Solution: QA28-29 was not receiving 24V
at XD34 8,9,10 to 11 - when you remove 24V , the MA1 reset and it's working

additional_info.subject: SiD MP / R4 170001688 6v7JXA: QA1 failure in feedback line
additional_info.body:
Dear Expert,
Sicharge D
S/N: MP / R4 170001688
ID: 6v7JXA
FW V2.11
XF3 Online with mobile SIM card
Charger is in storage for 2 years and is freshly open out of box, the moment we turn on the charger, we got this error.
The charger is showing the below error.
We had traced the cables from XD34 to KF5 and did not find any loose cables. All wiring are intact. We don’t understand why there is such failure in feedback line
Please let us know if there is any other wiring to check.
Thank you
Edna Seah

- A charger stored for two years showed a QA1 failure in the feedback line immediately upon being powered on, despite all wiring from XD34 to KF5 being intact and no loose cables found.
- The charger model is SiD MP / R4 170001688 with firmware version V2.11 and uses an XF3 Online system with a mobile SIM card.
- The user is requesting guidance on whether there are additional wiring checks to perform to diagnose the feedback line failure.
